title: Whitney's connectivity inequalities
statement:
For every finite nonempty simple graph $G$, the vertex connectivity, edge connectivity, and minimum degree satisfy
\[
\kappa(G) \;\le\; \kappa'(G) \;\le\; \delta(G),
\]
where $\kappa(G)$ is the least size of a vertex cut (or $|V(G)| - 1$ when $G$ has no vertex cut), $\kappa'(G)$ is the least size of an edge cut, and $\delta(G)$ is the minimum degree of a vertex of $G$.
